import hashlib,importlib.util,json
from pathlib import Path
home=Path("generators/d8111f3f714d/workspace/parametric")
def load(name):
 p=home/(name+".py")
 spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("_bounded_review_"+name,p)
 m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
 return m
family,audit=load("native_family"),load("audit_native")
grid=[[0]*30 for _ in range(30)]
grid[0][14]=grid[29][14]=2
minor=[c for c in range(30) if abs(c-14)>=2]
assert len(minor)==27
for r,c in zip(range(1,28),minor,strict=True):grid[r][c]=2
cases=[]
for orientation,value in [("v",grid),("h",[list(row) for row in zip(*grid)])]:
 facts=family.analyze_scene(value)
 assert facts["n_branches"]==27 and facts["orientation"]==orientation
 for direction,green_expected in [("toward_trunk",224),("away_to_edge",197)]:
  settings={"branch_direction":direction}
  got=family.python_apply(value,settings)
  assert got==audit.independent_apply(value,settings)
  green=sum(x==3 for row in got for x in row)
  assert green==green_expected and sum(x==2 for row in got for x in row)==29
  cases.append({"orientation":orientation,"setting":direction,"branches":27,"green_cells":green,"red_cells":29})
print(json.dumps({"schema":"arcpuzzles-branch-boundary-review-v1","status":"passed","source_sha256":{str(home/(name+".py")):hashlib.sha256((home/(name+".py")).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in ["native_family","audit_native"]},"cases":cases,"racket_evaluations":0,"limits":"Hand-constructed maximum-branch grammar boundary; two independent Python implementations and hand-derived cell counts only. This is not native qualification, all-seed coverage, or an extra reference replay."},sort_keys=True))
